_comment: The game's own settings. Every mod may have a game.json next to its mod.json: it goes over the mods' before it
key by key, so a mod names only what it changes. See docs/modding.md, "game.json".
title: the game's name, the window's title.
garage: the garage the game is played from: a mod's garages/<id>, else Assetto Corsa's showroom of that id.
language: the language of the files directly in the mods' text folders, played in when the player picks none.
Another language is a folder of that name in text (text/es), picked in Settings.
title: Street Corsa
